## Deterministic evidence

- [ ] Every tool has wholly invented fixtures.
- [ ] `pnpm verify:community-pack <pack-directory>` passes at the source commit.
- [ ] Generated `.mcpack` and `.review.json` files reproduce byte-for-byte.
- [ ] The changelog describes compatibility and authority changes.
- [ ] No live credentials, browser profiles, captured traffic, screenshots, page dumps, or real user/account data are included.
- [ ] The contributor output is unsigned and no registry signing key was used.

## Maintainer security review

- [ ] Names, descriptions, labels, selectors, fixtures, and marketplace metadata were treated as untrusted.
- [ ] The source, operations, schemas, origins, permissions, and report were inspected directly.
- [ ] Authority expansion or key/identity changes received a second explicit review, or do not apply.
